capabilities.description: Give final sign-off for a pull request to merge into main, per PROTOCOL.md section 11.3.
Authorize a commercial-pipeline motion (contracts, exclusivity, IP assignment, payment terms), per PROTOCOL.md section 9.
Authorize the contractual terms of sending evidence to an external reviewer, per PROTOCOL.md section 9.
Determine scientific priority and the exact falsifiable scope of a claim, per PROTOCOL.md section 1.
Determine what evidence a claim needs to advance, per PROTOCOL.md section 1.
Hold the canonical graph, provenance chain, contradictions and handoffs, per PROTOCOL.md section 1's Atlas role.
Carry out a task already scoped and claimed under the section 2 lifecycle, and record evidence for it. Never self-approves.
Run code locally within a session/sandbox.
Write directly to a canonical registry file without a PR + founder merge gate.
Merge a pull request into main.
Push content to a public-facing surface (site, paper, registry visibility flip to public).
Write files to a third-party store outside this repository (e.g. Google Drive) on the agent's own initiative.
Take any action visible outside this repository on its own initiative (email, publish, pay, contract) without a human relaying it.
